Stage 4: clean the detections of a run

Source: R/04_process_detections.R
pam_process_detections.Rd

Assembles the run's detections, applies pam_clean_detections() using the processing settings of the config, and writes the results to <detections>/<run_id>/processed/.

Usage

pam_process_detections(cfg, run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Detection run (sub-folder of paths$detections). Defaults to birdnet$run_id.

Value

A list: clean, removed, steps (see pam_clean_detections()).

Details

Writes detections_clean.csv, removed_detections.csv (with the reason for each removal) and processing_steps.csv. Times are written as local-time text. Run with pam_run_stage("04_process", pam_process_detections, cfg, run_id = "...").
